before.requirement: If allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
before.reason: On this conditional path, the old helper assigns XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to ctxt->errNo, which the harness reads through xmlXIncludeGetLastError.

after.requirement: If allocation of the document URL base fails during XInclude processing, expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY through the XInclude context.
after.reason: The replacement helper has no explicit ctxt->errNo assignment. Whether xmlRaiseMemoryError changes the code, and whether the harness can trigger this specific allocation failure, are unresolved.

claims.reason: The same document URL base allocation failure is assessed on both sides against the same old harness. The before path explicitly records the checked code; the after path delegates reporting, with feasibility and its effect on ctxt->errNo unresolved.
missing_information: fuzz/fuzz.c::xmlFuzzMemSetup and its installed allocation callbacks
configure.ac defaults governing XInclude in the supplied build recipe
The fuzz allocator callbacks and build defaults needed to establish whether a valid input can fail specifically at the document URL base allocation.
